messages:
erin: RCA is live for the weekend serving regression — https://redwood.internal/rca/2273000000-serving-regression
sam: appreciate the quick turnaround. can we summarize the short-term policy change up top of the doc?
maria: added a 'temporary policy' section: we disabled the fallback-to-quantized route for affected pools and raised per-route ratecap by 10% for retries. owner: @maria
ops: can we get exact rollback criteria in the doc? oncall needs a one-line abort condition.
erin: done — added rollback: abort and rollback patch if p95 > 620ms for 10m OR 5xx increase > 0.4%.
jae: I'll add an automated regression alert that targets the canary namespace and the global pools. PR will include the query + thresholds.
priya: drafting a short customer blurb for status page and marketing teams. will keep language minimal and notify comms channel for approval.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-04 03:15 UTC. Trigger: manual by @maria. Targets: 8% subset of eu-west pool.
maria: I'll run the canary and stream results here. planning a 10m validation window.
erin: added a compact validation checklist to the RCA under "canary checks":
```
1) replay 6m production tail to canary
2) ensure p95 <= baseline + 30ms
3) eviction_rate down >= 20%
4) no 5xx spike > 0.3%
```
sam: good. assigning owners in the doc:
- @maria: run canary + post results (due 2026-04-04)
- @jae: alert rule PR + runbook snippet (due 2026-04-09)
- @priya: statuspage blurb + comms (due 2026-04-05)
- @erin: host 30m checkpoint next week (suggested 2026-04-06 16:00 PT)
ops: please include load-test script snippet in the doc so we can replay without hunting repos.
erin: added a link to the load-test artifact and a tiny run command in the RCA.
comms-bot: Draft customer note created: /communications/drafts/2273000000-serving. @priya please review.
maria: starting canary tomorrow — will post minute-by-minute highlights. tagging @ops @sre
luis: reminder: include a note about the quantized-model fallback risk; small-context requests still OK but long-context may degrade.
erin: captured that risk under 'model variants' with mitigation options.
ops: syncing checkpoint scheduled for Mon 2026-04-06 16:00 PT; invite sent. mark if blockers appear.
infra-bot: rca-published link=https://redwood.internal/rca/2273000000-serving-regression tags=[reliability,policy,canary]
erin: thanks all — please add any missing action items inline in the doc. we'll re-open RCA if new signals show up.
